oracle.statement: leg A (fresh collection) describe returns 200 with points_count null (grid-tolerated, printed) or integer 0 - any other integer = Type4; leg B after a 200-acknowledged wait=true upsert of 5 points returns points_count integer exactly 5; leg C after a 200-acknowledged wait=true delete of 2 points returns points_count integer exactly 3 - in legs B/C null/absent/non-integer = Type4 (committed state not reflected) and a different integer = Type4 (untruthful counter); non-200 describe on the existing collection = Type1_IllegalRejection; upsert/delete mutation failures = SCRIPT_ERROR; indexed_vectors_count observed only (async optimizer timing); 5xx with /healthz alive = Type3
